title: Infer a Schema from Robot Episodes
summary: Propose signal shapes, metadata and per-channel observed ranges from a bounded collection of robot episodes.

physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Episode order and sample frequency are not inferred. Each signal is already aligned under its declared metadata.

provenance.authoring_notes: The paper motivates proposing schemas from observed data and reviewing them before enforcement. This numeric robot-signal schema and range policy are original; observed extrema are not hardware limits or a guarantee about unseen data.
